release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.5 fixes black/blank paid preflop range windows. Original range RGB pixels are written directly into native Tk PhotoImage surfaces instead of relying on the Windows PNG/PPM image decoder. Native Windows Tk verification renders and samples all 174 source images, including range #136. The full source audit confirms 174 IDs (128-301) and 174 image frames, with 171 unique semantic situations because three pairs are exact duplicate entries: 195/204, 196/205, and 238/243. The paid range remains 1BB per hand and uses exact live-state matching.
